Central Rio Blanco County in northwestern Colorado...

* At 226 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Lee Burn Scar. Between 0.3 and 0.6 inches of
rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 3 inches in
1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.
Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in debris flow.

loose materials.

flash flooding in and around the Lee Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches

across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in places. If
you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

Arroyos, streams, and rivers can become raging currents in a matter
of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.
